source_snapshot.procedure: Four one-hour thermal phases; select CPU in BurnInTest, then check CPU/memory/network full loading.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: MANUAL ONLY but identifies conflicting CPU-only versus CPU/memory/network coverage.

old_problem: The source explicitly selects CPU in BurnInTest while also requiring CPU, memory and network to be fully loaded; no approved rule chooses the authoritative workload.
disposition_reason: ED-14 preserves the exact four-hour transition and ED-15 forbids PASS without signed load floors. Choosing CPU-only or adding memory/network changes core coverage and command semantics, so the conflict cannot be converted into runtime parameters without project authority.
decision_basis: Direct XLSX row66 all 18 columns, same-row DeepSeek, history3099 and actual next row67/history3100 were read.
The four chamber phases and -5% rail condition are clear, but the commanded workload and asserted full-load coverage conflict in the same procedure.
Incidental Task Manager activity cannot prove intentional memory/network stress.
Tool/license, phase/load floors and recovery can be bound only after scope is adjudicated; no action ran.

test_case.purpose: After workload scope is approved, verify the specified domains remain within signed load floors throughout all four thermal phases at low rail without platform failure.
required_package: Per-domain load floors and phase/ramp tolerances
test_case.test_command: DO NOT RUN. First resolve the workload contradiction; then execute only the approved BurnInTest profile through 0C hold, ramp-up, 40C hold and ramp-down, each one hour, at signed -5% rails.
test_case.expected_result: Cannot be finalized until the authoritative workload domains and load floors are approved; afterward every required domain must remain loaded with no disallowed error/hang.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: No PASS is allowed by guessing CPU-only or adding memory/network. Every one-hour phase and the approved domain floors must be evidenced.
safety_gate: No chamber run until workload/profile is authorized
Abort on workload loss, moisture, rail, thermal, RAS or network fault
Preserve logs; no auto-retry; dry restoration
expected_evidence: Signed workload decision and tool identity
test_case.recovery: The approved scope must define coordinated workload stop; preserve phase evidence, return rails nominal, warm/dry, restore Windows/tool settings and do not auto-retry.

source_conflict.reason: CPU selection conflicts with required CPU/memory/network full load.

blocked.reason: Core workload semantics and acceptance floors cannot be inferred safely.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: Adjudicate workload scope, then bind tool/config/load floors, phase tolerances, low-rail limits and recovery.
pending.owner: Platform stress/project specification and margin-lab owners.
pending.unlock_condition: Approve authoritative workload domains and per-domain floors.

project_authority: Project owner must decide the conflicting coverage statement.
